persianMeaning: اشتیاق شدید؛ شور و هیجان زیاد
englishDefinition: A very strong feeling of love, anger, or enthusiasm that is clearly shown in a person's voice or actions.
example: Her passion for marine biology shaped the kind of research she chose for her thesis.
examplePersian: اشتیاق او به زیست‌شناسی دریایی، موضوع پژوهشی را که برای پایان‌نامه‌اش انتخاب کرد شکل داد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

persianMeaning: پرشور؛ سرشار از احساس و هیجان
englishDefinition: Showing very strong emotion or enthusiasm about something.
example: The candidate gave a passionate speech about protecting the forest that moved the whole audience.
examplePersian: نامزد سخنرانی پرشوری درباره حفاظت از جنگل ایراد کرد که تمام حاضران را تحت تأثیر قرار داد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Accepting what happens without trying to change it or oppose it.
example: The villagers remained passive during the flood, waiting for outside help instead of organizing themselves.
examplePersian: روستاییان هنگام سیل بی‌واکنش ماندند و به جای سازمان‌دهی خود، منتظر کمک بیرونی بودند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

persianMeaning: رنگ ملایم و روشن؛ رنگ پاستلی
englishDefinition: A pale shade of a colour, especially one used in a picture or in decorating.
example: The designer chose soft pastels for the nursery walls so that the room would feel calm.
examplePersian: طراح برای دیوارهای اتاق کودک رنگ‌های ملایم و پاستلی انتخاب کرد تا اتاق آرام به نظر برسد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Grassland where cattle, sheep, or other farm animals are allowed to feed.
example: The farmer rotated his herd between pastures to keep the grass from being exhausted.
examplePersian: کشاورز گله‌اش را میان چراگاه‌ها می‌چرخاند تا چمن‌زار فرسوده نشود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A piece of material sewn onto clothing to cover a hole or reinforce a weak area.
example: She sewed a patch onto the torn knee of her jeans before the exam.
examplePersian: او پیش از امتحان یک وصله روی زانوی پاره شلوار جینش دوخت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: An official document that gives an inventor the right to be the only person allowed to make or use an invention for a limited time.
example: The university filed a patent for the new cancer-detection method it had developed.
examplePersian: دانشگاه برای روش جدید تشخیص سرطان که توسعه داده بود اختراع‌نامه ثبت کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A way along which people or vehicles move, especially a narrow track between places.
example: A narrow path through the forest led the hikers down to the river.
examplePersian: مسیر باریکی در جنگل، کوهنوردان را به رودخانه رساند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: An organism such as a virus or bacterium that can cause disease in people, animals, or plants.
example: The laboratory identified the pathogen responsible for the outbreak in the water supply.
examplePersian: آزمایشگاه عامل بیماری‌زایی را که مسئول شیوع بیماری در منبع آب بود شناسایی کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: مسیر؛ راه و روش رسیدن به نتیجه
englishDefinition: A way of reaching a particular result or of doing something, especially a sequence of steps.
example: The program offers a clear pathway for students who want to transfer to a four-year university.
examplePersian: این برنامه مسیر روشنی برای دانش‌آموزانی فراهم می‌کند که می‌خواهند به دانشگاه چهارساله منتقل شوند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0

englishDefinition: The ability to stay calm and wait patiently for something difficult to happen or finish.
example: Working with young children requires far more patience than most people expect.
examplePersian: کار کردن با کودکان خردسال به مراتب بیش از آنچه بیشتر افراد گمان می‌کنند صبر می‌طلبد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

persianMeaning: بزرگ و سرپرست خانواده؛ ریشه‌انگار خاندان
englishDefinition: The man who is the respected leader of a large family and from whom the rest of the family descends.
example: In that community the oldest man often acts as the patriarch and settles disputes between relatives.
examplePersian: در آن جامعه، پیرترین مرد اغلب به عنوان بزرگ خانواده عمل می‌کند و اختلافات فامیلی را حل می‌کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Based on a system in which men hold the main authority in a family or society.
example: The report criticises the patriarchal structure that gave the eldest man sole control of the family business.
examplePersian: گزارش ساختار پدرسالارانه‌ای را نقد می‌کند که کنترل انحصاری کسب‌وکار خانوادگی را به بزرگ‌ترین مرد می‌داد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The act of murdering one's own father.
example: The court treated the patricide case as the most shocking crime of the decade.
examplePersian: دادگاه پرونده پدرکشی را تاریک‌ترین جنایت آن دهه دانست.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A person who loves their country and works to support or defend it.
example: Many of the founders of the republic were patriots who risked their lives for independence.
examplePersian: بسیاری از بنیانگذاران جمهوری میهن‌پرستانی بودند که جان خود را برای استقلال به خطر انداختند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Feeling proud of one's country and ready to support or defend it.
example: She felt patriotic pride when the national team won the final match abroad.
examplePersian: او وقتی تیم ملی در خارج از کشور فینال را برد، احساس غرور وطن‌پرستانه کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A group of people who move around an area at regular times to watch for problems, or the activity of doing this.
example: Two extra police were assigned to patrol the market during the festival.
examplePersian: دو مأمور پلیس اضافه برای گشت‌زنی در بازار هنگام جشنواره تعیین شدند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A person or vehicle whose job is to travel around an area and watch for problems or intruders.
example: Every patroller carried a radio so the base could be warned in seconds.
examplePersian: هر گشت‌زن یک بی‌سیم داشت تا پایگاه در چند ثانیه هشدار داده شود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A person who regularly supports a business, an artist, or a cause, often by spending money on it.
example: The museum's most generous patron bought a whole wing and named it after his family.
examplePersian: سخاوتمندانه‌ترین حامی موزه یک نمایشگاه کامل را خرید و آن را به نام خانواده‌اش نام‌گذاری کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: The support a patron gives to a business, artist, or institution, especially by spending money regularly.
example: The gallery survives on patronage, since it sells almost nothing to the general public.
examplePersian: گالری از محل حمایت مالی بقا می‌کند، چون تقریباً چیزی به عموم مردم نمی‌فروشد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: تحمیلی؛ از بالا و با نگاه فرورست به دیگران
englishDefinition: Behaving as if you are better or more important than other people, often in a way that seems polite but is really condescending.
example: His patronizing tone made the intern feel small in front of the whole team.
examplePersian: لحن تحمیلی او باعث شد کارآموز در برابر کل تیم خود را کوچک احساس کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A lack of something, especially a lack of a large enough quantity to be useful.
example: A paucity of affordable housing has pushed many graduates into a second job.
examplePersian: کمبود مسکن مقرون‌به‌صرفه بسیاری از فارغ‌التحصیلان را به سمت شغل دوم کشانده است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A person who has very little money and property, especially one who is supported by others.
example: The book follows a pauper who travels to the city in search of work.
examplePersian: این کتاب درباره بیچاره‌ای است که برای کار به شهر سفر می‌کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To cover a surface with a hard material so that people or vehicles can travel on it.
example: The city paved the muddy road with asphalt before the rainy season.
examplePersian: شهر آن جاده گلی را پیش از فصل باران‌ها آسفالت کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: The amount of money that a worker receives for a week or two weeks of work.
example: She used part of her paycheck to pay the electricity bill every month.
examplePersian: او بخشی از حقوق هفتگی‌اش را هر ماه برای پرداخت قبض برق کنار می‌گذاشت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Money that is paid for something, or the act of paying for it.
example: The final payment for the car cleared the remaining debt on the loan.
examplePersian: آخرین پرداخت خودرو باقیمانده بدهی وام را تسویه کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: The highest point of a mountain, or the point at which a value such as price, demand, or performance reaches its maximum.
example: Tourist numbers peak in July, when demand for rooms is at its highest.
examplePersian: شمار گردشگران در ژوئیه به اوج می‌رسد، زمانی که تقاضا برای اتاق‌ها در بالاترین حد است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A hard white or pale round object that forms inside a shell of an oyster and is used in jewellery.
example: The divers brought up a pearl the size of a small marble from the deep bed.
examplePersian: غواصان مرواریدی به اندازه یک تیله کوچک از بستر عمیق بالا آوردند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A small smooth rounded stone found on a beach or in a riverbed.
example: The child skipped a flat pebble across the surface of the pond.
examplePersian: کودک سنگریزه تختی را روی سطح برکه پرتاب کرد و روی آب جهید.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To strike or bite something repeatedly with a pointed beak, as a bird does.
example: A hungry woodpecker pecked at the bark until it found a beetle inside.
examplePersian: طوطی گرسنه با نوک به پوست درخت می‌کوبید تا درون آن سوسکی یافت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To steal money or property that has been entrusted to one's own care.
example: The treasurer was fired after it emerged that she had peculated thousands of dollars.
examplePersian: امین مالی پس از آنکه معلوم شد هزاران دلار را اختلاس کرده بود، اخراج شد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Strangely different from what is normal, or strange in a way that seems hard to explain.
example: He has a peculiar habit of counting the steps of every staircase he climbs.
examplePersian: او عادتی عجیب دارد که پله‌های هر راه‌پله‌ای را که از آن بالا می‌رود می‌شمارد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: An unusual or distinctive quality or feature of a person, place, or thing.
example: One peculiarity of the building is that no two windows are the same size.
examplePersian: یکی از ویژگی‌های متمایز این ساختمان آن است که هیچ دو پنجره هم‌اندازه نیستند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Connected with the theory or practice of teaching.
example: The move from lecture to discussion was a pedagogic decision, taken by the teaching staff rather than by the administration.
examplePersian: گذار از سخنرانی به بحث و گفت‌وگو تصمیمی آموزشی بود که کادر آموزشی به‌جای کادر اداری گرفت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: آموزشی؛ مربوط به تدریس و یاددهی
englishDefinition: Having to do with teaching or with the way a subject is taught to learners.
example: Her doctoral research examines how pedagogical methods affect students who learn slowly.
examplePersian: پژوهش دکتری او بررسی می‌کند که روش‌های آموزشی چگونه بر دانش‌آموزان کندآموز اثر می‌گذارد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The theory and practice of teaching, especially the methods used in a classroom.
example: Her lecture on pedagogy argues that language grows out of meaningful conversation.
examplePersian: سخنرانی او درباره پداگوژی استدلال می‌کند که زبان از گفت‌وگوی معنادار رشد می‌کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A person of about the same age and status as you, or a person who is equal to you in ability or experience.
example: First-year students learn more when they discuss the material with their peers.
examplePersian: دانش‌آموزان سال اول وقتی مطالب را با همتایان خود بحث می‌کنند بیشتر می‌آموزند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: So good or beautiful that nothing can be compared with it.
example: The reconstruction of the instrument was a peerless feat of nineteenth-century craft.
examplePersian: بازسازی آن ساز، دستاوردی بی‌همتا در هنر قرن نوزدهم بود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Of or relating to punishment, especially a punishment imposed by law.
example: A heavier sentence for repeat offenders is a central feature of the new penal code.
examplePersian: مجازات سنگین‌تر برای تکرارکنندگان جرم، ویژگی اصلی قانون کیفری جدید است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A punishment that is given to someone for breaking a rule or committing an offence.
example: Late arrival now carries a heavy penalty in most laboratories.
examplePersian: دیرآمدن در بیشتر آزمایشگاه‌ها اکنون جریمه سنگینی به همراه دارد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A strong liking for something, or a strong tendency to do a particular thing.
example: She has a real penchant for obscure nineteenth-century novels that nobody else reads.
examplePersian: او علاقه‌ای واقعی به رمان‌های ناشناخته قرن نوزدهم دارد که هیچ‌کس دیگری نمی‌خواند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A piece of jewellery that hangs from a chain or is fixed to a ring.
example: She added a small amber pendant to the chain her grandmother left her.
examplePersian: او یک آویز کوچک کهربایی به زنجیری که مادربزرگش برایش گذاشته بود اضافه کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Still waiting to be decided, confirmed, or completed.
example: The building permit is still pending, so work has not officially started.
examplePersian: مجوز ساخت همچنان در انتظار تأیید است و کار رسماً آغاز نشده.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A heavy weight hung on a string that swings regularly back and forth and is used in clocks.
example: The pendulum in the old clock swings back and forth with a very steady beat.
examplePersian: آونگ آن ساعت قدیمی با ضربانی بسیار منظم رفت‌وبرگشت می‌کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To move or pass into or through something, or to enter a place where few people go.
example: Sunlight can barely penetrate the dense canopy of this rainforest.
examplePersian: نور خورشید به‌سختی می‌تواند از پوشش انبوه این جنگل انبوه عبور کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Able to pass through a material, or sharp and clear enough to reach the listener's attention or feelings.
example: Her penetrating question reduced the whole committee to silence for a moment.
examplePersian: پرسش نافذ او برای لحظه‌ای کل کمیته را به سکوت واداشت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: An antibiotic medicine that was the first drug widely used to treat bacterial infections.
example: The doctor prescribed penicillin and the fever dropped within two days.
examplePersian: پزشک پنی‌سیلین تجویز کرد و تب ظرف دو روز فروکش کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A narrow piece of land that is almost surrounded by water and is joined to the mainland.
example: The port on the northern peninsula is ice-free all winter because of warm currents.
examplePersian: بندر شمالی شبه‌جزیره به دلیل جریان‌های گرم تمام زمستان یخ‌زده نیست.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: متفکر و اندوهگین؛ در فکر فرو رفته
englishDefinition: Lost in thought, especially in a quiet and slightly sad way.
example: She was quiet and pensive for the rest of the journey home.
examplePersian: او تا پایان راه بازگشت به خانه ساکت و اندوهگین بود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Extreme lack of money and basic necessities.
example: Records of the settlement describe a slow, grinding penury through the winter.
examplePersian: اسناد آن آبادی، فقری آهسته و فرساینده در تمام زمستان را توصیف می‌کندند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A relating to or measured as the average amount per person in a population.
example: The report compares per capita income across several countries and finds wide gaps.
examplePersian: این گزارش درآمد سرانه را در چند کشور مقایسه می‌کند و شکاف‌های بزرگی می‌یابد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To become aware of something through the senses or through careful thought.
example: The survey found that most students perceive the course as harder than it actually is.
examplePersian: این نظرسنجی نشان داد که بیشتر دانش‌آموزان این درس را دشوارتر از آنچه هست درک می‌کنند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A number expressed as a share out of a whole, usually out of a hundred.
example: A large percentage of the students who entered never finished the course.
examplePersian: درصد زیادی از دانش‌آموزانی که وارد شدند هرگز دوره را به پایان نرساندند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: The way a person understands or interprets something, based on senses or experience.
example: Public perception of the drug changed completely after the safety report was published.
examplePersian: برداشت عمومی از این دارو پس از انتشار گزارش ایمنی درباره آن کاملاً دگرگون شد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Able to notice and understand small details and differences that others may miss.
example: Her perceptive questions showed that she had understood the article far more deeply than the rest of us.
examplePersian: پرسش‌های تیزفهم او نشان داد که مقاله را بسیار عمیق‌تر از ما فهمیده بود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To sit or stand on something high, especially a branch or a ledge.
example: Two owls perched on the topmost branch and watched the field below.
examplePersian: دو جغد روی بلندترین شاخه نشستند و مزرعه پایین را تماشا کردند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To pass slowly through a material, as liquid through ground coffee, or as news through a group.
example: Rainwater continues to percolate down through the soil for many months.
examplePersian: آبار باران ماه‌های بسیاری به‌آرامی از میان خاک عبور می‌کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The playing of instruments that are struck with sticks or hands, such as drums and cymbals.
example: The percussion section of the orchestra practised until midnight in the hall.
examplePersian: بخش کوبه‌ای ارکستر تا نیمه‌شب در سالن تمرین کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A plant that lives for many years and produces flowers every year, or something that continues to exist for a long time.

englishDefinition: To do an action or a piece of work, or to present a play or concert for an audience.

englishDefinition: A person who plays music, acts, or dances in front of an audience.

examplePersian: اجراکنندگان جوان با دقتی بازی کردند که سنشان را پنهان می‌کرد.

englishDefinition: A liquid with a pleasant smell that is put on the skin, or the smell itself.

examplePersian: رایه ملایم یاس از باغ به داخل کشیده می‌شد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Serious and immediate danger or harm.

examplePersian: این گزارش درباره خطر ساخت خانه در دشت‌های سیل‌گیر ناپایدار هشدار می‌دهد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Extremely dangerous, especially because the danger is hard to control.

examplePersian: راهنما بدون طناب حاضر نبود گروه را در مسیر پرمخاطره رهبری کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The outer edge of a shape or an area.

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A length of time in which something happens, or a division of history.

examplePersian: برای مدتی کوتاه در دهه 1990 پول کشور نصف ارزش خود را از دست داد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Happening regularly at fixed times, again and again.
example: Periodic flooding of the delta has kept the farmland fertile for centuries.
examplePersian: سیلابی شدن دوره‌ای دلتا قرن‌ها زمین‌های زراعی را بارور نگه داشته است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0

englishDefinition: A magazine or journal that is published at regular intervals, such as monthly.

examplePersian: این نشریه ماهانه هر مقاله‌ای را که درباره شعر دوران قرون وسطی چاپ شده فهرست می‌کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Not central to the main subject, and therefore of secondary importance.
example: Computer vision remained a peripheral concern until the mid-1990s.
examplePersian: بینایی ماشین تا میانه دهه 1990 موضوعی فرعی به شمار می‌رفت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0

englishDefinition: The outer edge of an area, or a less important position compared with the centre.
example: Most of the new housing lies on the periphery, far from the historic centre.
examplePersian: بیشتر مسکن‌های جدید در پیرامون شهر و دور از مرکز تاریخی ساخته شده‌اند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Likely to go bad quickly, especially food that must be kept cold.

examplePersian: ماهی فاسدشدنی‌ترین غذای منو است و باید ظرف یک روز خورده شود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The crime of deliberately lying while giving evidence in a court of law.

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Continuing for a very long time or for ever, with no end in sight.
example: After years of seasonal work he finally obtained a permanent contract.
examplePersian: پس از سال‌ها کار فصلی، سرانجام قراردادی دائمی به دست آورد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Allowing liquid or gas to pass through its material.

examplePersian: غشای جدید در برابر آب نفوذپذیر است اما در برابر باکتری‌ها کاملاً نفوذناپذیر.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: نفوذ کردن؛ در همه جا پیچیدن
englishDefinition: To spread throughout a place or a group of people.
example: An atmosphere of open distrust has permeated every level of the organisation.
examplePersian: فضای بی‌اعتمادی آشکار در هر سطح سازمان نفوذ کرده است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Allowed by rules or by law.

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Official approval that allows somebody to do something.

examplePersian: او برای کار در شیفت شب در سال آخر تحصیل اجازه خواست.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Allowing people to do things that others might consider wrong or excessive.
example: The committee rejected the permissive reading of the statute as too vague.
examplePersian: کمیته برداشت سهل‌گیرانه از قانون را به دلیل ابهام بیش از حد رد کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: An official document that allows a person to do something that would otherwise be forbidden.
example: The council issued a building permit for the new warehouse.
examplePersian: شورا برای انبار جدید مجوز ساخت صادر کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Forming a right angle with another line or surface.
example: The two plates are welded perpendicular to the hull of the boat.
examplePersian: دو ورق فلزی به‌صورت عمود بر بدنه کشتی جوش داده شدند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To make something continue, especially a problem or an unfair situation, over many years.
example: The old system perpetuates the very inequality it claims to remove.
examplePersian: نظام قدیمی همان نابرابری‌ای را که ادعای رفعش را دارد تداوم می‌بخشد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To confuse somebody so much that they cannot understand what is happening.
example: The sudden change in the timetable perplexed even the senior students.
examplePersian: تغییر ناگهانی برنامه زمانی حتی دانش‌آموزان سال آخر را گیج کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Confusing in a way that makes somebody unable to understand or decide.
example: It is perplexing that two studies using the same data reached opposite conclusions.
examplePersian: گیج‌کننده است که دو مطالعه با داده‌های یکسان به نتایج متضاد رسیدند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Steady, patient effort over a long time in spite of difficulty.
example: After thirty rejections his perseverance finally produced a first book deal.
examplePersian: پس از سی پذیرش‌نشدن، پشتکار او سرانجام نخستین قرارداد کتاب را به دست داد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To keep trying to achieve something difficult, without giving up.

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To continue to exist, or to keep trying to do something firmly against resistance.

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: The quality of continuing firmly, or of continuing to exist.
example: The persistence of drought through the third summer surprised the relief agencies.
examplePersian: ادامه خشکسالی در طول تابستان سوم سازمان‌های امدادی را متعجب کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Continuing firmly despite difficulty, or continuing for a long time.

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: The collection of qualities that make a particular person different from others.

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A particular way of thinking about something, especially one's own position within it.

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To sweat, especially as a result of heat, fear, or effort.

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To make somebody agree to do something by giving good reasons.
example: A single experiment persuaded the committee to fund the whole project.

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Able to make somebody believe or do something, especially by giving strong reasons.

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Directly relevant to the particular subject being discussed.

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To disturb somebody's mind or calmness, especially by saying or doing something unexpected.
example: The professor was visibly perturbed by the question about the source of her data.

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Present everywhere in a place or situation, and therefore hard to avoid.

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To keep asking somebody for something in a way that annoys them.

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0

englishDefinition: A dangerous disease, especially one that spreads quickly and kills many people.

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Extremely harmful and spreading quickly like a deadly disease.

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: An animal that people keep for companionship rather than for work.

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: One of the coloured parts of a flower that attract insects and protect the centre.

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A formal written request addressed to an authority asking it to change something.

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The process by which the remains of an organism slowly turn into stone.

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To shock somebody so much that they are unable to move or think clearly.
example: The sight of the empty cradle petrified the young mother for a few seconds.

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Crude oil taken from the ground, from which petrol and other fuels are made.
example: The refinery processes petroleum from four neighbouring states.

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A stage in a process or development, or the physical state of matter in a given form.

examplePersian: مرحله نخست محاکمه تنها وقایع پرونده را احراز خواهد کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Observable events or facts that are studied in science, taken as a group rather than singly.

examplePersian: پدیده‌های نوری مانند شفق قطبی تنها در تاریکی کامل قابل مشاهده‌اند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To an extremely great degree, so that something causes surprise.

examplePersian: این شرکت نوپا به‌طور فوق‌العاده رشد کرد و ظرف چهار سال شعبه در خارج باز کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A natural event or fact that can be observed, especially one that is studied in science.

examplePersian: شکست نور پدیده‌ای است که هر مدرسه‌ای با یک لیوان آب می‌تواند نشان دهد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A referring to an orchestra or society whose purpose is to perform orchestral music at a high standard.

examplePersian: بلیت‌های کنسرت ارکستر فیلارمونیک پیش از آغاز فصل به‌طور کامل فروخته شد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The study of the history and structure of languages, especially ancient ones.
example: Her degree in philology prepared her to edit medieval manuscripts word by word.

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A person who studies philosophy, or who thinks carefully about the basic questions of life.
example: Each student must choose a philosopher and defend one of that thinker's arguments.

englishDefinition: Giving pleasure and satisfaction because of its quality or manner.

examplePersian: راهنما مسیری دلپذیر برگزید که تندترین بخش کوهپایه را دور می‌زد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: The feeling of enjoyment or satisfaction that something enjoyable gives you.

examplePersian: او برای لذت می‌خواند نه برای نمره و این در نوشتارش پیداست.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A formal promise to do something, sometimes made publicly as part of an official ceremony.
example: The organisers made a public pledge to publish every document they held.
examplePersian: برگزارکنندگان تعهد علنی دادند که هر سندی در اختیار دارند را منتشر کنند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: فراوان؛ در دسترس به مقدار زیاد
englishDefinition: Existing in large amounts, more than enough.

examplePersian: بارش باران در این منطقه فراوان است، اما تنها در فصلی بسیار کوتاه می‌رسد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Easy to bend or shape, and therefore easily influenced by other people.
example: Clay is still pliable when it is removed from the wheel.
examplePersian: خاک رس هنگام برداشتن از چرخ هنوز انعطاف‌پذیر است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Easily bent, and easily persuaded or controlled by others.

examplePersian: نگرش انعطاف‌پذیر او باعث شد مذاکره‌کننده تقریباً در هر بند کوتاه بیاید.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A difficult and unfortunate situation that somebody is in.
example: The report describes the plight of families who lost their fishing grounds.
examplePersian: این گزارش وضعیت اسفناک خانواده‌هایی را توصیف می‌کند که شیلات خود را از دست دادند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A secret plan to do something bad, made by a group of people.

examplePersian: پلیس توطئه‌ای برای سرقت قدیمی‌ترین نسخه‌خط‌های موزه را کشف کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To turn over the soil in a field with a plough, in preparation for planting.

examplePersian: کشاورز پیش از بذرکاری در بهار، زمین را دو بار شخم می‌زند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The courage and determination needed to do something difficult.
example: It took real pluck to admit publicly that the experiment had failed.
examplePersian: اعتراف علنی به شکست آزمایش شجاعتی واقعی می‌طلبید.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

persianMeaning: پر و بال؛ پرهای بیرونی پرنده
englishDefinition: The feathers covering the body of a bird, especially the coloured feathers on the outside.
example: Peacocks change the colour of their plumage before the mating season.
examplePersian: طاووس‌ها پیش از فصل جفت‌گیری رنگ پرهای خود را تغییر می‌دهند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To examine a problem or situation very carefully in order to find out what is really going on.

examplePersian: تیمی مستقل شش ماه حساب‌های بیمارستان را موشکافی کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A person whose job is to fit and repair the pipes and drains of a building.

examplePersian: نیمه‌شب که لوله زیر سینک ترکید، با یک لوله‌کش تماس گرفتیم.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

persianMeaning: لوله‌کشی؛ شبکه فاضلاب و لوله‌های ساختمان
englishDefinition: The system of pipes and drains inside a building, or the work of fitting and repairing it.
example: Old plumbing in the house cannot carry the load of modern appliances.
examplePersian: لوله‌کشی قدیمی خانه توان تحمل لوازم خانگی مدرن را ندارد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: سقوط کردن؛ سقوط تند و ناگهانی
englishDefinition: To fall steeply and suddenly in level, price, or number.

examplePersian: فروش دستگاه درپس از عرضه مدل جدید به‌شدت سقوط کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: تپل و گوشتالو؛ گرد و پر
englishDefinition: A describing a person or fruit that is pleasantly full and rounded rather than thin.
example: The cook added plums to the salad because the fruit was too plump to roast whole.
examplePersian: آشپز آلوها را به سالاد افزود چون میوه برای کبابی کردن کامل بیش از حد درشت بود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To take goods away by force, especially during a war or riot.
example: Soldiers plundered the market within hours of the ceasefire being announced.
examplePersian: سربازان ظرف چند ساعت پس از اعلام آتش‌بس بازار را غارت کردند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To fall or drop quickly and suddenly into something, especially deep water.
example: He plunged into the cold water and swam straight across the channel.
examplePersian: او در آب سرد شیرجه زد و مستقیم عرض کانال را شنا کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To work steadily at a trade or at a task, especially while others are not prepared to.
example: The old cobbler plied his trade in the same small lane for fifty years.
examplePersian: کفاش قدیمی نیم قرن در همان کوچه کوچک به حرفه خود ادامه داد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The amount of money a person has, or the things they can afford to buy.
example: The trip cost more than my pocketbook could bear that year.
examplePersian: هزینه سفر در آن سال بیش از توان مالی من بود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A person who writes poems.
example: The poet read from a manuscript that had never been published before.
examplePersian: شاعر از دست‌نوشته‌ای خواند که هرگز پیش از آن منتشر نشده بود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

persianMeaning: خونسردی؛ آرامش و اعتماد به نفس
englishDefinition: Calm confidence and self-control in the way somebody stands, moves, or speaks.
example: The young lawyer answered the hard questions with remarkable poise.
examplePersian: وکیل جوان با آرامشی چشمگیر به پرسش‌های دشوار پاسخ داد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A substance that causes death or serious harm if it is swallowed, breathed in, or touched.

examplePersian: توت‌های این بوته ماده‌ای سمی دارند که دستگاه عصبی را تحت تأثیر قرار می‌دهد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Relating to the North or South Pole, or having two ends with opposite electric charges.

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0

persianMeaning: قطبی کردن؛ به دو دسته متضاد تقسیم کردن
englishDefinition: To divide a group of people into two opposing sides, or to cause light to vibrate in one direction only.
example: The new housing rule polarized opinion, and both camps published full-page advertisements.
examplePersian: قانون جدید مسکن دیدگاه‌ها را قطبی کرد و هر دو اردوگاه آگهی تمام‌صفحه منتشر کردند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A long thin piece of wood or metal used to support or carry something.

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

persianMeaning: پولیش دادن؛ صیقل دادن؛ بهبود بخشیدن
englishDefinition: To rub a surface until it becomes smooth and shiny, or to improve the quality of something.

persianMeaning: براق و صیقلی؛ آراسته و شیک

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To carry pollen from one flower to another, so that new seeds can form.

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: An animal such as an insect or bird that carries pollen between plants.
example: Wild bees are the most effective pollinators of the region.

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To make air, water, or soil dirty by adding harmful substances to it.

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: The presence in air, water, or soil of harmful substances produced by human activity.

examplePersian: آلودگی هوا هر بار که دما بالا می‌رود و بی‌حرکتی هوا ایجاد می‌شود به‌شدت افزایش می‌یابد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A flat shape whose sides are all straight lines.

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Consisting of many straight sides rather than a smooth curve.

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To think about something carefully for a long time.
example: The committee pondered the proposal for an entire evening before voting on it.

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Maize grains that burst into fluffy pieces when heated.

examplePersian: سینما در ورودی ذرت بو داده و نوشیدنی می‌فروشد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Liked or enjoyed by a large number of people.
example: The lecture series is so popular that tickets are cancelled within hours.
examplePersian: مجموعه سخنرانی‌ها چنان محبوب است که بلیت‌ها ظرف چند ساعت لغو می‌شود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: The state of being liked or enjoyed by many people.

examplePersian: محبوبیت این مسابقات از سالی که شبکه پخش آن را آغاز کرده هر سال بیشتر شده است.

englishDefinition: Having a large number of people living in it.

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A very hard white material made from fine clay and baked at a high temperature, used for dishes and tiles.
example: Museum staff were handling the porcelain fragments with cotton gloves.
examplePersian: کارکنان موزه قطعات چینی را با دستکش نخی جابه‌جا می‌کردند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A large rodent with long sharp spines covering its back.
example: The porcupine had hollowed out a nest under the roots of the fig tree.
examplePersian: تشی لانه‌ای زیر ریشه‌های درخت انجیر کنده بود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A very small opening in a surface, such as in the skin or in a plant leaf, that a liquid or gas can pass through.
example: The membrane has pores that open and close in response to the light.
examplePersian: غشا منافذی دارد که در پاسخ به نور باز و بسته می‌شوند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Full of small holes that allow air or water to pass through.
example: The volcanic rock is so porous that rain water disappears within minutes.
examplePersian: سنگ آتشفشانی چنان متخلخل است که آب باران ظرف چند دقیقه ناپدید می‌شود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A small sea mammal with a blunt snout that breathes through a hole in the top of its head.
example: A porpoise surfaced beside the rowing boat and followed it for a while.
examplePersian: گراز دریایی در کنار قایق پارویی به سطح آب آمد و مدتی آن را همراهی کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Light and easy to carry or move from one place to another.
example: The laboratory equipment is fully portable and fits into two cases.
examplePersian: تجهیزات آزمایشگاه کاملاً قابل حمل است و در دو چمدان جا می‌شود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: نوید دادن؛ مقدمه و نشانه بدی بودن
englishDefinition: To be a sign that something unpleasant is going to happen.

examplePersian: ابرهای انباشته پیش از پایان هفته از طوفانی دیگر خبر می‌دهند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: One of several parts into which a whole thing is divided.

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A painted picture or photograph of a person, or a detailed description of somebody.

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: An artist who paints portraits of people.

sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The art of painting pictures of people, or the pictures themselves.
example: Her portraiture combines careful detail with surprising psychological depth.
examplePersian: پرتره‌سازی او جزئیات دقیق را با عمق روان‌شناختی شگفت‌انگیز ترکیب می‌کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To describe somebody or something in words, or to show somebody in a picture or film.

examplePersian: رمان روستایی را به تصویر می‌کشد که جز در خاطره نویسنده هیچ‌جا وجود نداشت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0

englishDefinition: The way somebody or something is described or shown in a work of art or literature.
example: Her portrayal of the politician in the play bears no relation to the real man.
examplePersian: بازنمایی سیاستمدار در این نمایش هیچ ربطی به مرد واقعی ندارد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0

englishDefinition: To present a particular kind of image, or to ask somebody a difficult question in order to make them appear foolish.
example: The council posed no direct questions about how the budget had been spent.
examplePersian: شورا هیچ پرسش مستقیمی درباره نحوه هزینه‌کرد بودجه مطرح نکرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Confident and sure that something will happen, or clear and useful in effect.
example: The professor sounded positive that the funding would be renewed.
examplePersian: استاد با اطمینان گفت که بودجه تمدید خواهد شد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To have something, or to be the owner of it.
example: The building possesses a roof that has not been replaced since the 1880s.
examplePersian: این ساختمان سقفی دارد که از دهه 1880 تعویض نشده است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: The state of having something, or the thing that you have.
example: A bicycle and a small tent are their only possessions.
examplePersian: یک دوچرخه و یک چادر کوچک تنها دارایی‌های آن‌هاست.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A place where soldiers, police, or guards stand while on duty.
example: Two soldiers stood watch at the post until the relief arrived.
examplePersian: دو سرباز تا رسیدن دسته بعدی نگهبانی از پاسگاه را بر عهده داشتند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: The money that you pay to send a letter or a parcel.
example: The card arrived without any postage stamp on it.
examplePersian: کارت بدون هیچ تمبر پستی به مقصد رسید.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Relating to the service that carries letters and parcels.
example: Postal delivery in the region is reliable but slow during the winter.
examplePersian: ارسال پستی در منطقه قابل اعتماد است اما در زمستان کند می‌شود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A card that you write a short message on and send by post without an envelope.
example: He sent a postcard from the ruins of the old abbey on the coast.
examplePersian: او کارت‌پستالی از ویرانه‌های صومعه کهن ساحل فرستاد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To put a date on something that is later than the real one.
example: The letter had been postdated by a week, which the clerk refused to accept.
examplePersian: تاریخ نامه یک هفته دیرتر زده شده بود و کارمند آن را نپذیرفت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A large printed picture or notice that is put up in a public place.
example: A poster in the station warns passengers to hold the handrail.
examplePersian: پوستری در ایستگاه به مسافران هشدار می‌دهد که دستگیره را بگیرند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: All the people who come after you, especially your children and their children.
example: The engineers planted trees that will shade the school for posterity.
examplePersian: مهندسان درختانی کاشتند که سال‌ها پس از آن مدرسه را سایه خواهند داد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A student who is studying for a degree above a first bachelor's degree.
example: She moved abroad as a postgraduate to study industrial chemistry.
examplePersian: او به‌عنوان دانشجوی تحصیلات تکمیلی برای مطالعه شیمی صنعتی به خارج رفت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0

persianMeaning: پس از مرگ؛ پس از درگذشت
englishDefinition: Published, awarded, or done after somebody has died.
example: The novel won the prize two years after the author received a posthumous honour.
examplePersian: این رمان دو سال پس از دریافت افتخار پس از مرگ نویسنده، برنده جایزه شد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The person who is in charge of a post office.
example: The postmaster agreed to hold the parcel until the address was corrected.
examplePersian: مدیر پستخانه پذیرفت بسته را تا اصلاح نشانی نگه دارد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Taking place or done after a surgical operation.
example: The surgeon checks every patient in the postoperative ward twice a day.
examplePersian: جراح هر بیمار را در بخش پس از عمل جراحی روزی دو بار معاینه می‌کند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To change an event to a later time or date.
example: The hearing was postponed until all the witnesses had returned from abroad.
examplePersian: این جلسه تا بازگشت همه شهودان از خارج به تعویق افتاد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: To suggest that something must be true, as a starting point for further reasoning.
example: The model postulates that the sea level has never changed over the period studied.
examplePersian: این مدل فرض می‌کند که تراز دریا در دوره بررسی‌شده هرگز تغییر نکرده است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The position in which somebody holds their body, or the official position taken on an issue.
example: The committee maintained a cautious posture and asked for more evidence.
examplePersian: کمیته موضعی محتاطانه داشت و شواهد بیشتری خواست.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: پس از جنگ؛ دوران پس از جنگ
englishDefinition: Happening or existing in the period after a war.
example: The postwar housing scheme was the largest public building project of the decade.
examplePersian: طرح مسکن پس از جنگ بزرگ‌ترین پروژه ساختمانی عمومی آن دهه بود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A deep round container used for cooking, especially one used over heat.
example: She set the pot on the stove and left the vegetables to simmer.
examplePersian: او قابلمه را روی اجاق گذاشت و سبزیجات را آرام پخت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A white substance containing potassium that is used as a fertiliser and in industry.
example: The old works manufactured potash from the salt deposits of the region.
examplePersian: کارخانه قدیمی از رسوبات نمکی منطقه پتاس تولید می‌کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A soft white metal that is found in minerals and is essential for plant growth.
example: Plants that receive plenty of potassium resist drought far better than those that do not.
examplePersian: گیاهانی که پتاسیم کافی دریافت می‌کنند در برابر خشکسالی بسیار مقاوم‌ترند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0

englishDefinition: Extremely strong in effect, or powerful and influential.
example: The report warns that the pollutant is harmless in small doses but potent in large ones.
examplePersian: گزارش هشدار می‌دهد که این آلاینده در دوز کم بی‌خطر اما در دوز زیاد بسیار مؤثر است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Existing as a possibility that could become real if the right conditions occur.
example: The site has clear potential for housing, but it has no water supply at all.
examplePersian: این محل ظرفیت روشنی برای اسکان دارد اما هیچ منبع آبی ندارد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: The natural power that a person or thing has to develop and succeed in time.
example: Every acorn holds the potentiality of a whole oak tree.
examplePersian: هر بلوط توپی، توان نهفته یک درخت کامل بلوط را در خود دارد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Grown in a pot rather than in open ground, or preserved in a sealed container.
example: The potted palms lined the covered walkway between the two buildings.
examplePersian: نخل‌های گلدانی راهروی سرپوشیده میان دو ساختمان را پوشانده بودند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A person who makes objects out of clay by shaping them and baking them in a kiln.
example: The potter fired the bowls twice before they were ready for use.
examplePersian: کوزه‌گر ظرف‌ها را پیش از آماده شدن برای استفاده دو بار در کوره پخت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Objects made from clay that is shaped and baked in a kiln, or the craft of making them.
example: A shelf of Neolithic pottery stood between the older bronze vessels.
examplePersian: قفسه‌ای از ظروف نئولیتیک میان ظروف برنزی قدیمی‌تر قرار داشت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Birds such as chickens, ducks, and geese that are kept for their meat or eggs.
example: The farm keeps poultry rather than large animals, so the soil is not exhausted.
examplePersian: این مزرعه به جای دام‌های بزرگ، پرندگان اهلی نگه می‌دارد تا خاک فرسوده نشود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A unit of weight equal to about 454 grams, used in Britain and the United States.
example: The parcel weighed under a pound and cost very little to send.
examplePersian: بسته کمتر از یک پوند وزن داشت و هزینه ارسال بسیار کمی داشت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: The state of having very little money and not enough to meet basic needs.
example: The survey measured poverty by income against the cost of a basic food basket.
examplePersian: این نظرسنجی فقر را با سنجش درآمد در برابر هزینه یک سبد غذایی پایه سنجید.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A substance made of very small dry particles.
example: She dusted the tart with powdered sugar just before serving it.
examplePersian: او درست پیش از سرو، تارت را با شکر پودری آذوقه کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Possible to do in practice, using the money, time, and materials that are really available.
example: The committee judged the repair scheme practicable but far too costly.
examplePersian: کمیته طرح تعمیرات را شدنی اما به‌مراتب پرهزینه دانست.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Relating to real situations and actions rather than to ideas or theory, and therefore useful.
example: The course gives practical training in how to operate the machine safely.
examplePersian: این درس آموزش عملی ایمن‌کار با دستگاه را ارائه می‌دهد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: The quality of being useful and workable in real situations.
example: The practicality of the design was questioned as soon as the first batch failed.
examplePersian: عمل‌پردازی طراحی به‌محض خراب شدن نوبت اول زیر سؤال رفت.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: Almost completely, or in a way that concerns real situations and actions rather than theory.
example: The flood practically destroyed two seasons of harvest in a single night.
examplePersian: سیل در یک شب عملاً دو فصل برداشت را از بین برد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A person who is qualified and paid to practise a particular profession, such as medicine or law.
example: Her teacher was a medical practitioner with twenty years of clinical experience.
examplePersian: استاد او پزشکی با بیست سال سابقه بالینی بود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0

englishDefinition: A wide flat area of grassland with very few trees.
example: Grasshoppers crossed the prairie and stripped the fields bare in an afternoon.
examplePersian: ملخ‌ها از پرایری گذشتند و ظرف یک بعدازظهر کشتزارها را لخت کردند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To express approval of somebody or something, especially by saying good things about it.
example: The reviewers praised the plain style of the report while criticising its data.
examplePersian: منتقدان سبک بی‌پیرایه گزارش را ستودند و داده‌هایش را نقد کردند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

persianMeaning: پرت و پلاک سخن گفتن؛ بیهوده گفت
englishDefinition: To talk at length about things that are unimportant.
example: He prated on about his car while nobody else had a word to say.
examplePersian: او درباره ماشینش پرت و پلاک می‌گفت در حالی که هیچ‌کس سخنی نگفته بود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To give a religious talk to a group of people, or to urge something strongly.
example: The minister preached on patience while the congregation waited for the rain.
examplePersian: وزیر درباره صبر موعظه کرد در حالی که جماعت منتظر باران بودند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Not secure, and likely to fall apart or collapse without warning.
example: The bridge has been in a precarious state since the flood washed away its footings.
examplePersian: پل از زمانی که سیل پایه‌هایش را شست، در وضعیتی ناپایدار به سر می‌برد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: An action taken in advance to protect against something bad happening.
example: As a precaution, the flight was grounded while the engines were inspected.
examplePersian: به عنوان اقدامی پیشگیرانه، پرواز تا بازرسی موتورها زمین‌نشان نگه داشته شد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

persianMeaning: پیش از چیزی آمدن؛ مقدم بودن
englishDefinition: To happen or to come before something else in time or order.
example: A short summary precedes each chapter in the textbook.
examplePersian: خلاصه‌ای کوتاه پیش از هر فصل در کتاب درسی آمده است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: An earlier case or decision that is used as an example to justify a later one.
example: The appeal court followed the precedent set two years earlier in a similar case.
examplePersian: دیوان استیفا از سابقه‌ای که دو سال پیش در پرونده‌ای مشابه تعیین شده بود پیروی کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Coming or happening before something in time or order.
example: The preceding chapter explains why the experiment was never repeated.
examplePersian: فصل پیشین توضیح می‌دهد چرا آزمایش هرگز تکرار نشد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Very valuable, or loved very much.
example: The region is precious because it holds almost every kind of bird found on the island.
examplePersian: این منطقه گرانبهاست زیرا تقریباً هر نوع پرنده جزیره را در خود جای داده است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

persianMeaning: شتاب‌زده باعث شدن؛ ناگهان پیش رفتن
englishDefinition: To make something happen suddenly and without warning.
example: A careless remark at the meeting precipitated a dispute that lasted for weeks.
examplePersian: یک جمله بی‌احتیاط در جلسه مناقشه‌ای به‌بار آورد که هفته‌ها طول کشید.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0

englishDefinition: Water that falls from the sky as rain, snow, sleet, or hail.
example: Annual precipitation on the ridge is high but falls almost entirely in winter.
examplePersian: بارش سالانه در این یال از فاصله زیاد است اما تقریباً تماماً در زمستان می‌بارد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0

englishDefinition: Done suddenly and without enough thought, or extremely steep.
example: The precipitous withdrawal of the workers left the project without staff.
examplePersian: خروج شتاب‌زده کارگران پروژه را بدون نیروی انسانی رها کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Exact and accurate, with no doubt or error.
example: The instrument gives a precise reading of temperature to within a fraction of a degree.
examplePersian: این دستگاه درجه حرارت را با دقتی در حد کسری از یک درجه نشان می‌دهد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: The quality of being exact and accurate.
example: The instrument records temperature with a precision that earlier models could not reach.
examplePersian: این دستگاه دما را با دقتی ثبت می‌کند که مدل‌های پیشین به آن نمی‌رسیدند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To make something impossible, or to stop somebody from doing something.
example: The heavy rain precluded any attempt to climb the ridge that day.
examplePersian: باران شدید هرگونه تلاش برای صعود به آن یال را در آن روز ناممکن کرد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: A person or thing that comes before something else and shows that it is likely to happen.
example: Storms on the Atlantic are a common precursor of the sudden warm spells in autumn.
examplePersian: طوفان‌های اقیانوس اطلس نشانه‌ای رایج از گرمای ناگهانی پاییزی هستند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: An animal that hunts and eats other animals, or a person who takes advantage of others.
example: Wolves returned to the valley once the main predator had been driven away.
examplePersian: گرگ‌ها به‌زودی به دره بازگشتند، زمانی که شکارچی اصلی از آنجا رانده شد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0

englishDefinition: Living by hunting other animals, or behaving in a way that is designed to exploit others.
example: The lake is a stopover for predatory birds that nest on the offshore rocks.
examplePersian: این دریاچه ایستگاه میانی پرندگان شکارچی‌ای است که روی صخره‌های دریایی لانه می‌کنند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: The person who held a position or office before the present holder.
example: Her predecessor negotiated the agreement that the current board is now revising.
examplePersian: پیشین او توافقی را مذاکره کرد که هیئت فعلی اکنون در حال بازنگری آن است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: To say that something will happen, usually because you have good reasons to believe it.
example: Ecologists predict that the reed beds will shrink if the water level continues to fall.
examplePersian: زیست‌بوم‌شناسان پیش‌بینی می‌کنند که اگر تراز آب همچنان بیفتد، نیزارها کوچک خواهند شد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: The quality of being predictable, so that what will happen can be foreseen in advance.
example: Engineers value predictability far more than they value a clever new design.
examplePersian: مهندسان پیش‌بینی‌پذیری را بسیار بیشتر از طرح نو و هوشمندانه ارزش می‌گذارند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Able to be predicted, or behaving in a regular way that is easy to guess.
example: Because the timetable is predictable, travellers can plan the whole day around it.
examplePersian: چون برنامه زمانی قابل پیش‌بینی است، مسافران می‌توانند کل روز را حول آن بچینند.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: A statement about what you think will happen in the future.
example: The prediction of the drought's length proved far too short a season.
examplePersian: پیش‌بینی طول خشکسالی فصل را بسیار کوتاه برآورد کرده بود.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; NGSL/NAWL CC BY-SA 4.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

persianMeaning: پیش‌بین؛ توان پیش‌بینی از راه داده
englishDefinition: Able to show what is likely to happen in the future, especially through analysis of data.
example: The model proved highly predictive once rainfall records from four decades were added.
examplePersian: این مدل با افزوده شدن سوابق بارش چهار دهه، بسیار پیش‌بینانه از کار درآمد.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0; CEFR-J commercial use with attribution

englishDefinition: More common or more influential than anything else in a particular place or situation.
example: Granite is the predominant rock in the hills around the new quarry.
examplePersian: گرانیت سنگ غالب در تپه‌های پیرامون معادن جدید است.
sourceLicense: ECDICT MIT; Openjam MIT; EnglishToPersianDictionaries Apache-2.0

englishDefinition: Almost entirely, or for the greater part of a period or number.
